links.outcome: Uncertainty communication score of chatbot responses to orthodontic misinformation prompts, compared across five models
links.effect: Uncertainty communication differed across models (all six graded outcomes P < 0.001); 9.7% of 340 responses were unsafe; ChatGPT had the highest or joint-highest medians on the graded outcomes.
links.quote: The evaluated chatbots often avoided overtly unsafe advice, but their performance differed materially in factual quality, evidence alignment, active correction of misleading premises, calibrated uncertainty, transparency, and usable next steps.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the safety, accuracy, and misinformation handling of five commercial LLMs on simulated patient prompts regarding orthodontic misinformation, without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
